text: しゃちょう　でしたら　ただいま　１１かい　やくいんしつで　ございます

structure.jp: しゃちょう　でしたら
structure.en: if it's the president you want

structure.jp: １１かい　やくいんしつで　ございます
structure.en: he is in the boardroom on 11F

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.span: しゃちょう　でしたら
patterns.explanation: でしたら is the polite form of なら, 'if it is that you mean'. しゃちょう　でしたら = 'if it's the president you're after'.

patterns.name: 〜でございます
patterns.span: やくいんしつで　ございます
patterns.explanation: でございます is a very polite です used by staff to visitors. やくいんしつで　ございます = 'it is the boardroom'.
